lang.title: Choose your language
lang.hint: You can change the language later in your profile.
welcome.title: Your training. Your plan.
welcome.text: Answer a few questions (about 7 minutes). Then you get your training and nutrition plan.
welcome.disclaimer: This app gives general training and nutrition advice. It does not replace medical advice. You train at your own risk.
empty.today.title: Your session will appear here
empty.today.text: Your profile is saved. The plan is built in the next step.
empty.plan.title: Your plan will appear here
empty.plan.text: All weeks and sessions will be listed here.
empty.progress.title: No data yet
empty.progress.text: As soon as you log your first workout or weight, you will see your progress here.
profile.title: Profile
profile.disclaimer: This does not replace medical advice.
q.invalid: Please enter a value between {min} and {max}.
q.geschlecht: Which sex should be used for the calculation?
h.geschlecht: Only for the calorie formula. For diverse or no answer, an average is used.
q.gewicht_kg: What do you weigh right now?
q.zielgewicht_kg: Do you have a goal weight?
h.zielgewicht_kg: Optional. The app never sets a value below BMI 18.5.
q.bb_phase: Which bodybuilding phase are you in?
h.bb_phase: Contest prep is only safe with a coach and a doctor. This app does not plan it.
q.hyrox_division: Which Hyrox division do you start in?
q.lauf_level: How long can you run easily without stopping?
q.kraft_erfahrung: How long have you trained strength regularly?
q.trainingstage: How many days per week do you want to train?
q.dauer_min: How much time do you have per session?
q.schritte: How active are you in daily life?
q.schlaf: How much do you sleep on average?
q.s1: Has a doctor told you that you have a heart condition or should only exercise under medical supervision?
q.s2: Do you have chest pain or pressure during exercise or in daily life?
q.s3: Do you sometimes feel dizzy or lose consciousness?
q.s4: Do you have a bone, joint or soft-tissue problem that could get worse with exercise?
q.s5: Do you take medication for your heart or blood pressure?
q.s6: Are you pregnant, or did you give birth in the last 6 months?
q.s7: Is there any other reason why you should not exercise?
q.verletzungen: Any complaints we should take into account? (multiple)
q.essstoerung: Have you ever had problems with eating behavior (for example an eating disorder)?
h.essstoerung: If yes or no answer, the app shows no calorie numbers.
q.kochzeit: How much time do you have to cook per meal?
q.mahlzeiten: How many meals per day suit you?
res.title: Your profile is ready
res.sub: This is what the app understood.
res.flag.yellow: Please ask your doctor before you start heavy training.
res.flag.nutri: Calorie numbers are switched off for you. You still get meal ideas.
res.red.title: Please check this with a doctor first
res.red.text: Based on your answers, a doctor should clear you before you train. Your answers are saved. Then we continue.
today.deload: Deload week: fewer sets, same or lighter weight.
today.hint: Pick a weight where you could still do about 3 more reps.
today.done.title: Workout done
today.nosets: Tick at least one set to finish.
today.blockdone: You finished the 12-week block. A new block follows soon.
today.superset: Short on time: pair this with the next exercise (superset).
note.cap_days: You chose more days than is sensible for your level. Your plan uses {n} days.
note.endurance: Your endurance sessions come in the next update. This plan covers the strength part.
q.ziele: What are your goals? (you can choose several)
h.ziele: Tip: pick what matters to you now. Endurance goals and muscle gain together slow each other down.
q.prioritaet: Which goal matters most right now?
o.ort.studio_hyrox: Gym with Hyrox equipment (sled, SkiErg, rower, wall balls)
q.heim: What do you have at home? (multiple)
q.mag: What do you like to eat? (multiple)
h.mag: The more you pick, the more variety you get. If you like everything, choose that.
note.recomp: Building muscle and losing fat at the same time works best slowly. Expect small steps, especially if you are new to training.
note.endu_conflict: Muscle gain and endurance goals compete for recovery. Your plan puts your top priority first.
note.event_soon: Your race is closer than a full plan needs. The plan is shortened, so aim to finish well, not for a personal best.
info.title: How to do it
info.de_only: These tips are in German for now. The English version follows.
coach.goals.title: Your goals
coach.goals.text: Your plan adapts automatically to your results. Only change your goals here if they really change.
coach.qa.hint: Tap an exercise to see how it is done.
nutri.note.min: Your target is set to the safe minimum. A bigger deficit is not sensible without guidance.
nutri.note.cut: Expected change: about {kg} kg per week. Faster is not better.
nutri.note.muscle: A small surplus supports muscle gain. Gain slowly and steadily.
nutri.off: Calorie numbers are switched off for you. You still get meal ideas, new every week.
nutri.weeknote: New suggestions every Monday. A single day does not need to be exact: the weekly average counts.
nutri.proteinhint: Tip: add quark, skyr or a protein shake to reach your protein target today.
nutri.shop.title: Shopping list for this week
nutri.shop.hint: Amounts for one person, raw weight. Pick what you already have at home.
nutri.disc: These are estimates, not medical advice.
